create.name: Ashtanga Yoga Kyoto – Sadhana Shala
create.bio:
Ashtanga Yoga Kyoto is a traditional Mysore-style shala in the Nakagyō ward of central Kyoto, led by Keigo Yamaguchi. He began studying with Sharath Jois in Mysore in January 2012, assisted there, and received level 2 authorisation from him in 2014. He started the school in April 2015 by borrowing a dance studio in Shijō Karasuma for early-morning practice, moved it to Demachiyanagi in 2017, and in June 2019 opened his own room near Karasuma Oike, which was blessed with a puja by Swami Chetanananda. He called it Sadhana Shala to show that posture practice is meant as a means of spiritual practice.

Students learn the sequence at their own pace with individual help in Mysore classes every weekday morning, and a weekend Mysore programme is taught by Kunio Nakatsukasa, who trained with Nancy Gilgoff, David Swenson and Keiko Armstrong on Maui before assisting at the shala; he also covers while Keigo is away. New students are asked to watch a class before starting. Guest teachers come for weekend workshops, and from 22 November 2026 the shala moves to a new third-floor room near Marutamachi station.

courses.title: Yuya Sarashina WS (12–13 December 2026)
courses.description: A weekend with guest teacher Yuya Sarashina at the new shala: Mysore practice each morning and two 90-minute workshops, one on breath, drishti and vinyasa in the basic sequence and one on how primary practice relates to the later series. Beginners are welcome.

Moving: the shala leaves its Karasuma Oike room after 20 November 2026 and opens at FAZ BLD 3F, Higashinotōin-Takeyamachi, Nakagyō-ku from 22 November 2026 (access page). The two photos of the shala (interior and sign) show the old room.
The email on the site is Cloudflare-protected and was not decoded; the new-student / visit form is used as the contact route.
Keigo Yamaguchi's profile says that 'a new journey began with his family from August 2025' without saying more; Kunio Nakatsukasa covers long absences. Check who teaches day to day if this matters.
Teacher training: none advertised; included as an authorised Ashtanga lineage shala.
Possible future listings: Keigo Yamaguchi, Kunio Nakatsukasa; guest teacher Yuya Sarashina.
